d:
Hmm, maybe there be somethin' you can do for the Hand now that me think 'bout it. Yes, Jes'rimon could use your help for sure.
In Un'Goro Crater there be raptors with deadly claws. Some of those raptors sometimes have white claws instead of ones black like death. The Hand have... Clients... That like weapons crafted from these claws. Bring me many of those white claws, and me pay you good coin. Do it fast enough, and maybe me help you in other ways.
troll-male
p: Me clients are not so patient, friend. Have you gotten any of the claws yet?
c:
Ah, these do nicely. Thank you, friend. An' you be here long before they needed... That be good.
Maybe we have a weapon fashioned for you from the claws. What do you say?
troll-male

d:
While you have been exploring Un'Goro, I have seen other things that a mighty hunter such as yourself would relish in. One such sight was a huge ape among the other gorillas to the north. You have been to that cave before, but this time, I wonder if you'll survive the encounter if you accept my task.
I call him U'cha, and he is one of the Earth Mother's greatest sons, of that you can be sure. Defeat U'cha and bring me his pelt. Do this, and I will defend your right to call yourself a great hunter.
tauren-male
p: U'cha... The beast was magnificent. Huge and red, with teeth the size of daggers. His arms as thick as tree trunks, and as fast as any mountain lion I have ever laid eyes upon. You should consider yourself lucky to find such a test of bravery--my people would go generations without seeing such a creature.
c:
Well done, friend. I am pleased. You have done a great thing here today.
U'cha was one of the greatest apes I had ever seen. The fact that you have bested his strength speaks well of your own strength... And courage.
It is only fitting that I give you this as a sign of respect. You have earned it.
tauren-male

d:
The information you have given me about the pylons is very interesting...
Give me a moment to do some calculations, friend. Speak to me again in a moment and I should be able to give you the answer we have been looking for.
gnome-female
c:
Alright, friend. This is fascinating... I can only hope that my diagrams are correct! I compiled everything into this manual, which you can have.
I believe I can answer any questions you have about the crystals now, friend.
gnome-female

d: We need to get out of here, friend. Help me get my gear back from the supply area and free my friends. If we make it out of here, you are to proceed to Morgan's Vigil and speak with Marshal Maxwell. He will give you further instruction.
human-male
p: You look exhausted, friend. Perhaps you should have a seat by the fire and relax.
c: Amazing, friend. Simply amazing. Windsor stormed through here not five minutes ago. He makes some grand claims but purports that they are supported by his evidence. He is on his way to Stormwind now to confront Bolvar and... Lady Prestor.
human-male

d:
Although my little brother Ribbly has been worthless his whole life, I think, finally, he has some value! But... We might need your help to capitalize on Ribbly's newfound worth.
My sister Yuka has been looking for him for weeks, and tracked him to the Burning Steppes. She sent word to me, asking for some hired hands.
So, what do you say? Want to help? If so, then speak with my sister. You'll find her holed up in Flame Crest, a cave northwest of Dreadmaul Rock.
goblin-female
c:
Yes, I'm looking for my brother. We must find him and retrieve him, bless his heart.
But if we can't bring all of him... Then his head will suffice.
goblin-female

d:
You have been to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan? Did you happen to run into a pitiful lout named Kharan Mighthammer? The dwarf that was supposedly watching over my baby girl!
And now she's gone, friend!
I have had my men turn the Steppes upside down. The only clue they have as to the whereabouts of my daughter is that she may be inside the Depths. For all I know, she could be dead!
Kharan is supposedly being held prisoner there... Find him! I want answers!
dwarf-male
c: Please, let me explain.
dwarf-male

d: Please, hear me out before passing judgement!
dwarf-male
p: Allow me to finish telling my story.
c: As you can see, there was nothing I could have done.
dwarf-male

p: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a windblossom plant. The berries that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
c: You apply two Cenarion plant salves to the windblossom. It immediately begins to shed its corrupted form, blossoming into a vibrant and healthy plant.

d: You must take this information back to King Magni, friend. He will know what to do!
dwarf-male

It would seem as if my old adversary, Dagran Thaurissan, has me and the kingdom of Ironforge at his mercy.
You may be my last hope, friend. You must rescue my dear daughter, Moira!
There is only one way to make sure that the spell Thaurissan has cast on Moira is broken: Kill him.
And friend, do not harm her! Remember, she is being controlled by Thaurissan! The things she may do or say are a result of Thaurissan's evil spell!
dwarf-male
c:
Princess Bronzebeard weeps over the loss of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
Why???
dwarf-female

d:
Thaurissan was a great and honorable dwarf. You ruined my life and the life of my unborn child!
You think that Princess Bronzebeard may still be suffering from the residual effect of the Emperor's spell.
Return to Ironforge and tell my father that the heir to the Kingdom of Ironforge will be a Dark Iron dwarf.
Whether he approves or not, it shall be.
dwarf-female
c:
It seems that even in death, Thaurissan has won.
You are dismissed, friend. Before you leave, you may choose your reward from the royal vault.
King Bronzebeard slumps into his throne to mull over this bizarre change of events.
dwarf-male

p:
The Pylon table allows you to combine green power crystals with yellow power crystals.
According to J.D.'s manual, this combination can be used to heal yourself or your allies.
c:
Arranging the crystals on the table, you carefully align the colors. As you push the last one into place, a burst of light fuses the crystals together.
The resulting combination is now yours.
